findings.title: Template change waits for pods to be deleted (OnDelete)
findings.cause: StatefulSet cache's pod template has changed, and 2 of its 2 pods still run the old one: its updateStrategy is OnDelete, which replaces a pod only when the pod is deleted, so the change reaches none of them until someone does

evidence.what: StatefulSet cache: current revision cache-856bc7c797, update revision cache-847dfc6486, 0 of 2 pods updated
evidence.command: kubectl get statefulset cache -n kd-statefulset-ondelete -o jsonpath='{.spec.updateStrategy.type}{" "}{.status.currentRevision}{" "}{.status.updateRevision}{" "}{.status.updatedReplicas}/{.status.replicas}'

findings.fix: Delete the old pods one at a time (each comes back with the new template), or set updateStrategy type RollingUpdate on StatefulSet cache to have the controller do it: kubectl rollout status statefulset/cache then follows it.
